one_liner: DataForSEO offers a broad pay-as-you-go REST API for SEO data (SERP, keywords, backlinks, etc.) with HTTP Basic auth, a free trial/sandbox path, and a vendor-described official MCP server.
auth_notes: Fetched pages show only HTTP Basic (login:password, base64) for the REST API. The draft's OAuth2 claim applied only to the MCP server and is not supported by the provided pages, so it was removed from REST auth_methods.
access_notes: Docs point to a free trial, sandbox and API playground, and the site has a free signup. Production use is pay-as-you-go with a $50 minimum top-up and no subscription. The specific "$1 trial credit" and "sandbox never charged" quotes were not in the provided pages, so this is only medium confidence.
blocker_notes: Real data needs a prepaid balance ($50 minimum top-up), but there is a free trial/sandbox path to start building.

evidence.quote: Yes. The minimum account top-up is $50.
DataForSEO provides a massive ecosystem of 15+ specialized APIs.
DataForSEO API is using the [REST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) technology
DataForSEO is the way to go because it provides an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
